title: Agent onboarding, roles and access security

useCases.title: Register as a shipping agent
mainFlow: A shipping agent registers with a company name, port licence number and a contact e-mail address, and is activated by a Berth Officer.

useCases.title: Automatic suspension on overdue invoices
mainFlow: An agent with three or more overdue invoices is automatically suspended.
A suspended agent cannot submit booking requests; bookings that are already Approved remain valid.
There is no self-service reactivation; a suspended agent is reactivated only by the Harbour Master.

useCases.title: Four user roles with layered authority
mainFlow: Four user roles exist: Shipping Agent, Berth Officer, Harbour Master and Inspector.
The Harbour Master can perform every action a Berth Officer can, plus decision overrides, agent reactivation and tariff maintenance.
Every user has exactly one role.

useCases.title: Company-scoped data visibility
mainFlow: Agents can only see bookings, invoices and inspections that belong to their own company.
